name: filters-nested-attributes
title: Deep attribute menus for large libraries
description: Deep attribute menus for large libraries. Core/Data Display/FilterBar pattern composed from @gaudi/design-system/core/FilterBar and other public Gaudi components; the components stay package imports.
docs: Copy-in pattern built on @gaudi/design-system; the components stay package imports. Load '@gaudi/design-system/global.css' once and add transpilePackages: ['@gaudi/design-system'] in Next.js. Until the package is on npm, install it from GitHub first: pnpm add github:ahmadassaf/design-system.
